Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you for your hard work.

[EN] Kill {@LinkCreature:46#201#argonomorph kulkari crusher}, {@LinkCreature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shaman}, and {@LinkCreature:46#203#argonomorph Lokian slayer} and collect tokens.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to the nearest coordinator.
[ES] Informa al coordinador más cercano.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
